events.summary: 为该 Bun/TypeScript 项目新增最小化的内存版 NoteStore，并在仅允许的两个文件中补充对应的 bun:test 用例，使 `bun test ./src/note-store.test.ts` 通过。

Implement a minimal in-memory NoteStore in TypeScript with two files: `src/note-store.ts` (Note interface + NoteStore class backed by Map) and `src/note-store.test.ts` (5 bun:test scenarios). The project scaffold already provides package.json (ESM), tsconfig.json (strict), Bun runtime, and an empty src/ directory. No other files should be created or modified.
